parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(1.98<X<2.03)=P\!\left(\frac{1.98-2.02}{0.03}<Z<\frac{2.03-2.02}{0.03}\right)=P(-1.333<Z<0.333)$ [M1]
Guidance: Standardise at least one boundary using mean $2.02$ and standard deviation $0.03$. Condone variance notation $0.03^2$ and continuity correction $\pm0.005$, but not division by $\sqrt{0.03}$.
$\Phi(0.333)-[1-\Phi(1.333)]=0.6304+0.9087-1$ [M1]
Guidance: Calculate the appropriate interval area from the two standardised values, such as $\Phi(0.333)-[1-\Phi(1.333)]$.
$P(1.98<X<2.03)=0.539$ [A1]
Guidance: Award a result from $0.539$ inclusive to $0.5395$ exclusive, dependent only on the preceding area method. If no method mark is earned, special-case B1 is available for a value in this interval.
Total: 3

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(X>2.6)=\frac{134}{5000}=0.0268,\quad P(X<2.6)=0.9732$ [B1]
Guidance: Accept $0.9732$, $4866/5000$ or $2433/2500$ as the lower-tail probability.
$\frac{2.6-2.55}{\sigma}$ [M1]
Guidance: Use the standardisation formula with $2.6$ and $2.55$ substituted; do not use variance, square-root the unknown, or apply a continuity correction.
$\frac{2.6-2.55}{\sigma}=1.93$ [M1]
Guidance: Equate the substituted standardisation expression to a value rounding to $\pm1.93$.
$\sigma=0.0259\text{ kg}$ [A1]
Guidance: Accept a value rounding to $0.0259$ or the exact equivalent $5/193$. If no method mark is earned, special-case B1 is available for the correct final answer.
Total: 4
